players.product: proprietary single-molecule tracking (SMT) platform with AI/ML-guided drug discovery

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier MSD (pembrolizumab for Eikon's combination trials): Eikon has Clinical Trial Collaboration and Supply Agreements with MSD International Business GmbH for three studies - the Phase 2/3 registrational study of EIK1001 in advanced melanoma (dated August 1, 2024), the Phase 1/2 trial of EIK1005 in advanced solid tumors (dated December 3, 2025) and the Phase 2/3 registrational study of EIK1001 in NSCLC (dated December 5, 2025). Eikon sponsors the trials at its own cost and MSD supplies pembrolizumab at its own cost; each agreement expires on delivery of the final report of the pembrolizumab portions of its trial (or if a Phase 2/3 trial's Phase 3 portion is not initiated), and MSD may terminate a trial's supply if Eikon does not initiate that combination trial within one year of the agreement's effective date.

quarterly_data.counterparty_role: supplier of pembrolizumab (at its own cost) for Eikon-sponsored combination trials

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing model: Eikon does not own or operate, and has no plans to establish, manufacturing facilities; it relies on third-party contract manufacturers for bulk drug substances, drug products, raw materials, samples, components and other materials, and it has no agreements with third-party manufacturers for the long-term supply of any product candidate. Where necessary it intends to identify and qualify redundant manufacturers, including long-term agreements for active pharmaceutical ingredients and drug product, before submitting an NDA or BLA to the FDA or a marketing authorization application to the EMA.

10-K expense breakdown for 2025: research and engineering expenses were $130,433 thousand (2024: $130,114 thousand), clinical expenses $117,385 thousand ($69,672 thousand) and in-process research and development $2,500 thousand ($4,750 thousand), for total R&D of $250,318 thousand ($204,536 thousand); G&A was $88,627 thousand ($55,807 thousand) and net loss $324,248 thousand ($243,814 thousand). Purchases of property and equipment were $46,741 thousand ($84,803 thousand), and the accumulated deficit was $920.5 million as of December 31, 2025.
